overview: ICP Nexus is a comprehensive Internet Computer portfolio management and community platform. Track ICP holdings with live prices, plan exit strategies, join community chat, and stay informed with the latest ICP news — all secured with Internet Identity.
features: Live ICP price tracking with multi-source fallback
Exit strategy planner with multiple price targets
Community chat with reactions, image uploads, and YouTube previews
ICP news feed from aggregated RSS sources
Admin panel with live wallet balance
